args.title: Clarify deliberate byte order mark in CSV exports
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

Clarify that the byte order mark at the start of CSV exports is deliberate and intended for spreadsheet applications.

label: question
file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The byte order mark at the start of CSV exports is deliberate, as noted in src/export/csv.ts, to help spreadsheet apps detect UTF-8.
